creation: Before the world existed, there was God, and there was only God. And God made the entire world. He made the land, the sky, the oceans, and everything that's in them. And He also made all the various kinds of animals in the world. And after this, God also made a man. This is how He made him. He took dust from the ground and formed a person. Then He breathed into his nose, and instantly, the man became alive. God also made a garden. In the garden, there were different kinds of trees and many delicious fruits on these trees. And God put the man in the garden to live there and take care of it. And so he did. One day, God brought all the animals before the man and told him to name them all. So, one by one they came, and he named everyone of them. Now, every animal had its own companion, but the man was alone. So, God put that man into a deep sleep, and took a rib from him, and made a woman. Then God brought the woman before the man, and he was so happy and said "Wow, she is just like me." Then God blessed the man and the woman and put them in charge over all that He made. And God looked across everything He created, and it was perfect. There was no sin, there was no suffering. Everything was perfect.
the-first-sin: The man and woman lived in the garden God made. In this garden there were many delicious fruits. And there was also a certain tree to know the difference between good and evil. God told the man and woman, "You can eat any fruit you want in the garden. But don't eat the fruit on the tree to know the difference between good and evil. If you eat it, you'll die." One day a snake came to the woman and said, "Did God say you can't eat any fruit in the garden?" The woman replied, "God told us we can eat the fruit of any tree. But we're not allowed to eat the fruit on the tree to know the difference between good and evil. If we eat it, we will die." Then the snake said, "You're not going to die. In fact, if you eat it, you'll be just like God. That's why He told you not to eat this fruit." Then the woman thought about what the snake said, and she wanted this knowledge the fruit could give her. So, she ate it. Then she gave some to the man beside her, and he also ate it. Now before, the man and the woman were naked, but they didn't know they were naked. But after they ate the fruit, they immediately knew they were naked and were embarrassed and ashamed. Well, sometime later God came into the garden, and the man and the woman were afraid, and hid among the trees. Then God called out, "Hey, where are you?" Finally, the man came and told God everything the 2 of them had done. And of course he blamed the woman for everything. Then the woman herself blamed the snake for everything. And so, God punished them 1 by 1. He told the woman, "You're going to suffer a lot of pain during childbirth." And to the man, He said, "You're going to struggle a lot to get food." Lastly, God told them, "And one day, you are going to die." Then God kicked the man and woman out of the garden. From then on, there was sin and suffering in the world. But God had compassion on them, and He continued to help them in their lives.
daniel-reads-gods-word-and-prays: Many years ago, God’s people had sinned against Him and refused to obey Him. So God allowed their enemies to conquer them and take them away from their homeland. One of God’s people was a man named Daniel and he was different. He had a close relationship with God and spent time with Him by praying to Him every day and reading His Word. One day, Daniel was reading God’s Word, and he read what God had told one of His prophets. The capital of his homeland would remain destroyed for 70 years. As Daniel read God’s Word, he realized that the 70 years were almost finished and that God’s people could return home. So, Daniel began praying to God that He would do all that He promised in His Word. Daniel prayed like this, “God, You are great and faithful, but we have sinned against You and are covered in shame. Please forgive us and help us, not because we deserve it, but so that You will be honored.” While Daniel was praying, God sent an angel to him. The angel said to Daniel, “As soon as you began to pray, God gave an answer because He loves you so much.” Then the angel began to reveal to Daniel more of what God planned to do. And soon after this, God’s people began returning to their homeland.
birth-of-jesus: After the first man and woman sinned, there became more and more people in the world, and there became more and more evil and suffering. Most people rejected God and did whatever they wanted (and even worshipped other gods). God was not happy about this all, but He still had compassion on everyone. So, in order to save all people from their sins, He sent a Savior. And this is how He did it. 2,000 years ago, there was a woman named Mary. Now Mary had never slept with anyone, but she was engaged to a certain man named Joseph. And they both loved God very much. One day, an angel came to Mary and said, "You are going to give birth to a Son. And He is God's Son and will be very great." And so, Mary became pregnant even though she had never slept with anyone. When Joseph discovered that Mary was pregnant, he thought about breaking off the engagement. Then one evening, an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream. The angel said, "Don't break up with Mary. God has put this child in Mary. And this child will save people from their sins." So, Joseph did not break up with Mary, and the two of them got married. After this, the two of them went to the hometown of their ancestors. But, at that time, all the hotels were full, and they had no place to stay. So, they ended up staying in a barn. That evening, Mary gave birth to a Son, and His name was called Jesus. The name Jesus means, "God saves". Now in the area, some shepherds were taking care of their sheep. Suddenly, many angels arrived in the sky, and the shepherds became scared. But one angel said, "Don't be afraid. I come with Good News. Today a Savior has been born nearby." So, the shepherds went and visited Savior Jesus, and they were so happy and were praising God.
how-to-pray: One day Jesus was on a hillside teaching his followers how to pray. Jesus said “When you pray, don’t pray in such a way that people will see you and think you’re super-spiritual. Just pray by yourself in your room and God will hear you.” And when you pray, don’t keep repeating prayers over and over. That’s a waste of time. God won’t hear you because you keep repeating prayers. God already knows what you need even before you even ask Him. Then Jesus said, “Here is an example of how to pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, may everyone on earth worship You and obey You just like everyone does in heaven. And please give us the food we need to live each day. Also, protect us from Satan’s evil plans and help us not to sin when he tempts us to sin against You. And if we do sin against You, please forgive us of our sins and we will forgive others when they sin against us. And so, like this, Jesus taught His followers how to pray.
the-paralyzed-man: Savior Jesus grew up, and when He was 30 years old, He started going to many places teaching about God and healing the sick. At this time Savior Jesus became famous. One day Jesus was in a house teaching about God, and there were lots of people who came to listen to Him, so much so that people were spilling out of the house. While He was teaching, some people brought a paralyzed man on a stretcher to be healed by Jesus. But since the house was so full, they couldn't get to Jesus, so they went on the roof and somehow made a hole in it and lowered the paralyzed man right in front of Jesus. When Jesus saw their faith, He looked at the paralyzed man and said, "Your sins are forgiven". Now there were some religious leaders in the crowd. When they heard Jesus say this, they were thinking to themselves, "What? He can't say that. Only God can forgive sins". Well, Jesus knew what they were thinking and He turned to them and said, "What's easier? To say your sins are forgiven, or get up and walk? I'll show you I can forgive sins." And Jesus turned to the paralyzed man and said, "Get up and go home". Immediately, the man jumped up, grabbed his mat and walked out praising God. And everyone was amazed and said, "We have never seen anything like this before".
the-death-of-jesus: Savior Jesus never sinned or did anything bad at all, but some people hated Him and wanted to kill Him. So, one evening while Jesus was praying in a garden, religious leaders suddenly came with soldiers and arrested Him. And that night they held a secret trial where lots of people lied about Jesus, and they sentenced Him to death. The next morning soldiers beat Jesus with a jagged whip until He was almost unrecognizable. Then they made Jesus carry a huge wooden cross and led Him to the place of execution. When they arrived at the place of execution, they spread His arms out on the wooden cross and nailed a stake in each hand. Then they crossed His feet and nailed a stake into them as well. And they lifted up the large wooden cross where Jesus hung there dying. But in the midst of this all, Savior Jesus prayed for His executors saying, "God, forgive these people. They don't understand what they are doing." The crowd who was watching this whole spectacle began mocking Jesus and said, "This man supposedly saved other people, but look at Him now. If you really are the Savior of the World, then save yourself and come down off the cross." But Jesus didn't respond to them or do anything at all, and He remained there hanging on the cross. Finally, after several hours on the cross, Savior Jesus said, "It is finished", and He died. And the people who were beside the wooden cross suddenly began crying. And even a soldier said, "This man really was the Son of God." Then, after this, some people took Jesus' body off the cross and buried Him in a tomb.
the-resurrection: After Savior Jesus died on the cross, some people buried His body in a tomb. Three days later, some women who believed in Jesus went to His tomb. When they arrived there, the tomb's entrance was open, and Jesus' body was no longer there. And they were shocked and confused. Suddenly, 2 angels appeared and said, "Jesus is not here. He has come back to life." The women were so happy and ran back and told Jesus' closest followers the news. But they thought the women were crazy and didn't believe them. That evening, as Jesus' closest followers were gathered together, Jesus suddenly appeared. And they were completely scared thinking it was a ghost or something. Jesus said to them, "Don't be afraid. Look, It's me." And when they saw that Jesus really had come back to life, they were so excited. Then Jesus explained to them why He needed to die and come back to life. If someone wonders why Jesus had to die and come back to life, this is why: Whoever has sinned, God must punish that person just like He did with the first man and woman. But just as God had compassion on the first man and woman, He also has compassion on us and sent the Savior Jesus to die on a cross in our place in order to take the punishment we deserve and cleanse our sins. Whoever turns away from their sin and believes in Savior Jesus alone, that person's sins are not only cleansed, but they will be like a brand-new person. This is the good news about Jesus.
jesus-calms-the-storm: One day Jesus was teaching a crowd about God. When evening came, Jesus decided to head to the other side of the lake. So, He and His closest followers got in a boat, and they started across the lake. And Jesus fell asleep in the back of the boat. Well, a little while later as they were crossing the lake, a severe storm developed. And the wind and the waves started bashing the boat and flooding it. So, the closest followers woke Jesus up and they asked Him, "Don't you care if we die?" So, Jesus stood up, and He told the storm, "Stop!" And it did! The wind stopped, and the water was completely calm. Then He turned to His closest followers and He asked, "Why were you afraid? Where is your faith?" Well, the closest followers were stunned, and they asked each other, "Who is this guy? Even the wind and the waves obey Him."
the-man-with-many-demons: Jesus and His closest followers arrived at the other side of the lake after He had stopped the storm. And there was a man living there who had lots of demons. He was violent, walked around naked, screaming, and he even cut himself with rocks. He was completely out of his mind. As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, the man started screaming and running towards Jesus. And when he got to Jesus, he fell on the ground and began yelling, "What do you want Jesus, Son of the most-high God? Please don't hurt us." Jesus asked them, "What's your name?" The demons replied, "Our name is Army, because there's a lot of us in this man." Now, close by on a hillside there were about 2,000 pigs that were grazing. And the demons begged Jesus, "Please don't send us far away, send us into these pigs instead." So, Jesus cast the demons out and allowed them to go in the pigs. When the demons entered them, the pigs went crazy and ran down the side of the hill right into the lake, and they all drowned. The men who were taking care of the pigs saw what happened, and they ran into town and told everyone about it. Soon, a large crowd came out to see what happened. When they got to there, they saw the man who had been filled with all the demons sitting quietly in his right mind and fully clothed. And it freaked them out, so much so that the crowd began begging Jesus, "Please just go away! Do not bother us anymore!" So, Jesus and His closest followers got in the boat to leave. But as He was getting in the boat, the man who had the demons began to say, "Please, Jesus, let me go with you!" Jesus turned to him and said, "Go back to your family and tell them about everything that God's done for you, and how He showed you mercy." So, the man did just as Jesus had told him. He went back and told his family everything God did. But he not only told them, he went and told everyone in the surrounding towns about what Jesus had done for him, and everybody was completely amazed.
jairus-daughter-and-the-bleeding-woman: After Jesus cast the demons out, He and His closest followers went back to the other side of the lake, and there was a large crowd waiting for them there. And a man named Jairus ran up to Jesus and said, "Jesus, my daughter is dying, please come and heal her." So, Jesus went with him to his house, and the large crowd also went along with them. In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for 12 years. She had seen lots of doctors and spent all of her money. But, in the end she only got worse. The woman thought, "If I could just touch his clothes, I know I'll be healed." So, she worked her way through the crowd and came up behind Jesus and reached out and touched His robe. All of sudden, the bleeding stopped and she could feel that she was all better. Well, Jesus felt that power had gone out of Him, and He immediately stopped and turned around and said, "Who touched me?" One of Jesus' closest followers said to Him, "What do you mean 'who touched you'? There is a huge crowd pressing all around you." But Jesus kept looking around to see who touched Him. Finally, the woman came forward, and she was so afraid that she was literally shaking, and she fell on her knees in front of Jesus and told Him everything that happened and how she had been healed. And Jesus said to the woman, "Daughter, your faith has made you well. You're not going to suffer from this anymore." At the same time, someone from Jairus's house came and said to the man, "Don't bother Jesus anymore. Your daughter has died." But Jesus looked at Jairus and said, "Don't be afraid. Just believe". So, they continued to the house. When they got to the house, they saw a huge crowd had gathered and were crying over the girl's death. Then Jesus took Jairus and his wife, and three of His closest followers and went into the room where the girl's body was. Then He took the girl's hand and said to her, "Little girl, get up". And immediately she got up. And everyone was amazed.
feeding-the-5000: One day Jesus and His closest followers got in a boat and tried to go off to a quiet place to get some rest. But a large crowd of about 5,000 men and their families saw them and met them at their destination. When Jesus saw the crowd, He was filled with compassion because they were like sheep without purpose and direction in life and they needed a shepherd. So, He began teaching them many things about God. As it started getting late in the day, Jesus' closest followers came up to Him and said, "We need to send everyone away so they can go get something to eat." Jesus said, "You give something to eat." And they were like, "With what? Do you know how much money it would cost to buy this many people food?!" And Jesus replied, "Well, go and see how much bread you can find." So, they came back and told Him, "We have 5 loaves of bread and 2 fish, that's it." Then Jesus took the bread and fish and thanked God for them. And He began breaking the bread into pieces and started handing them to the closest followers to give to the people. And He kept handing it to them and handing it to them and it just never ran out. And then in the same way He divided up the fish and gave everyone fish to eat. And out of those 5 loaves of bread and 2 fish, the thousands of people there ate as much as they wanted and even had lots of leftovers.
the-widows-offering: One day Jesus was sitting in the main temple, and He was watching the crowd as they gave their offerings. And lots of rich people came by and put in large amounts of money. Then a poor widow came along and put in two small coins that were hardly worth anything. Jesus called His closest followers over to Him and said, “Look at this poor widow. I tell you the truth, she has given more than all of those other people. See, they all gave from what they had left over. But she’s poor, and yet she gave all she had to live on.”
the-good-samaritan: One day a religious leader came up to Jesus to test Him. And he said, “Teacher, what do I have to do to have my sins forgiven and live in heaven forever?” Jesus said, “Well, what does God’s Word say?” And the man said, “Love God with all your heart, and love your neighbor in the same way you love yourself.” And Jesus said, “That’s right. Do that, and you’ll live in heaven forever.” But the man wanted to make himself look good, so he asked, “Okay, but who is my neighbor?” So Jesus told him a story. There was a man walking along a road, and some robbers attacked him. They took his clothes and beat him up, and they left him lying there half dead. Sometime later, a religious leader came by and saw the man lying there. But he ignored him and kept on going. Then another religious leader came by and saw him too, but he did the exact same thing and didn’t help him either. Finally, another man came along, but his people hated the people of the injured man. Even so, when he saw the man lying there, he felt so sorry for him. So he went over to him and bandaged him up and took him to a hotel where he paid for his continued care. Then Jesus asked the religious leader, “So, which of these three was a neighbor to the man the robbers beat up?” And the man said, “The one who showed him mercy.” And Jesus said, “Then go and do the same.”
zacchaeus: One day there was a large crowd following Jesus and there was a short man named Zacchaeus in the crowd. Zacchaeus collected taxes from people, and he became very rich because he would collect more money than he was supposed to and cheat people. Well, Zacchaeus tried to get a look at Jesus as he passed by, but he was so short he couldn’t see over the crowd! So, Zacchaeus ran ahead and climbed a tree so he could watch Jesus as He walked by. Well, when Jesus came by, He looked up in the tree at Zacchaeus and said, “Zacchaeus, get down. I’m going to stay at your home.” Zacchaeus was so excited and hurried and got down. But the crowd was mad and they said, “I can’t believe Jesus is going to this terrible person’s house.” And Zacchaeus stopped and said to Jesus, “Lord, I’ll give half of everything I own to the poor. And if I’ve cheated people on their taxes, I’ll repay them four times as much.” Jesus responded, “Salvation really has come to this house today. See, I came to look for people who are lost and save them from their sins.”
the-last-supper: On the night before Jesus was killed, there was a big annual feast that celebrated when God delivered His people out of slavery called the Passover. Jesus told His closest followers that He really wanted to eat this special meal with them because the meaning of this Passover meal was about to be fulfilled by His suffering. During this meal, Jesus took some bread, He thanked God for it, and gave it to His closest followers and said, “Eat this bread. It represents my body which will be given for you. Keep doing this new custom to remember my sacrifice.” Jesus did the same thing with a cup of wine. He took the cup and said, “Drink this. It represents my blood that will be shed for the forgiveness of sins.” After they finished the meal, they sang a praise song to God.
the-samaritan-woman: Jesus was going from village to village teaching about God. One day, He and His closest followers were passing through a region called Samaria. And Jesus was tired and thirsty, so He stopped by a well. Soon, a Samaritan woman came to the well, and Jesus asked her for a drink of water. The woman was shocked by His request, because Jews and Samaritans didn’t get along with each other at all. And the woman said to Jesus, “Why are you asking me for a drink? You’re a Jew and I’m a Samaritan.” And Jesus said, “If you actually knew who I was, you would be asking me for a drink, and I would give you living water.” The woman said, “How are you going to get this living water? You don’t even have a bucket!” Jesus said, “Look, anybody who drinks from this well will get thirsty again, right? But whoever drinks the water that I give them will never be thirsty again and it will give life to their soul.” The woman said, “Give me some of that water!” But Jesus said, “Why don’t you go back into the village and get your husband.” The woman said, “Well, I don’t have a husband.” And Jesus said, “I know. In fact, you’ve had five husbands. And you’re not even married to the guy you’re living with right now.” The woman said, “Sir, I can see that You’re a prophet. I know that one day the Savior of the World will come and He will teach us everything.” And Jesus said, “You’re correct. I am that Savior!” The woman was so excited that she dropped her bucket and ran into the town to tell the people, “There’s a man who’s told me everything I’ve ever done! Could this be the Savior of the World?” Many people believed in Jesus because of what the woman told them and they asked Jesus to stay in town. So, Jesus stayed there two more days, and even more people believed in Jesus.
man-born-blind: One day Savior Jesus and His closest followers saw a blind man. And His closest followers asked Him: "Why is this man blind? Is it because his parents sinned? Or because he himself sinned?" Jesus replied: "Neither. It's not because either one of them sinned. It's so that God can show His power in his life." Then Jesus spit on the ground and made a small piece of mud and rubbed it in the eyes of the blind man. Then He said to the blind man, "Go to this certain pool and wash your eyes." So, the blind man went to the pool and washed off his eyes, and all of a sudden he could see. And when he came back to town everyone couldn't believe what happened and the religious leaders asked him, "How were your eyes healed?" He replied, "The man named Jesus healed me." But the religious leaders didn't believe him because they hated Jesus. So, the religious leaders brought his parents in and asked them if this was true or not. Now, the parents were very afraid of the religious leaders because they had said if anyone believes in Jesus, they would be kicked out of the synagogue (house of worship). So, the parents refused to back up their son's story of how he was healed. So, the religious leaders called the guy back in and said, "Tell us the truth. Who really healed your eyes?" He replied, "I told you, Jesus healed me. He has to be from God." Well, this infuriated the religious leaders. And they mocked him and kicked him out of the synagogue (house of worship). Jesus heard about everything that happened, so He went and found the man. And He asked him, "Do you believe in the Savior of the world?" The man replied, "Who is He? I don't know who He is, but I want to believe." Then Jesus said, "I am the Savior of the world." Then the man said, "Yes, I believe in You," and he fell on his knees and began worshipping Jesus.
the-early-church: In the early days of the church, the people who believed in Jesus were always spending time together. Every single day they would gather at the main temple and go to each other’s house to eat meals together and take the Lord’s Supper. These believers really loved and cared for one another! They willingly shared what they had, and were even selling their own possessions so they could give money to anyone who was in need. And whenever they gathered together, they listened closely as Jesus’ closest followers taught them God’s Word. They would also spend lots of time praying and worshiping God together. The people around these believers saw all that was happening and thought very highly of these believers. Not only that, the people saw the miracles that God was doing through Jesus’ closest followers and they were completely in awe! And because of all of this, every day more and more people were believing in Jesus and being cleansed of their sins.
the-apostles-persecuted: God was doing amazing miracles through the closest followers of Jesus, healing the sick and casting out demons, and so, many more people believed in Jesus. When the religious leaders saw what was happening, they became very jealous. So they arrested the closest followers of Jesus and threw them in jail. But during the night, an angel opened the jail doors and brought them all out. And the angel said, “Go to the main temple and tell the people all about the new life God gives.” So, early the next morning, they went right back to the main temple and started teaching again. Meanwhile, the religious leaders had the guards go to the jail to bring out the closest followers of Jesus. But the guards came back and said, “They’re gone. The jail was locked tight, and guards were standing right there. But when we opened the doors, there was nobody inside!” And the religious leaders were totally confused. Then all of a sudden, someone came running in and said, “Those men you put in jail are in the main temple right now, teaching all the people!” So, the guards went and brought the closest followers back. And the head of the religious leaders said, “We told you to stop teaching about this man! But you’ve filled the whole city with your teaching.” Then the closest followers said, “We’re going to obey God, not people. You killed Jesus, but God raised Him back to life! And He made Jesus the Savior of the World so that the people of God’s sins would be forgiven.” Well, when the religious leaders heard that, they were furious and wanted to kill them. But one religious leader stood up and said, “Leave these men alone. If this is all just their own idea, it’ll fail. But if it’s from God, you’re not gonna stop them.” So, the religious leaders agreed with him. But they still had the closest followers beaten with whips and ordered them to never speak about Jesus again. And the religious leaders finally let them go. When the closest followers left, they were so happy about everything because it was such an honor to be able to suffer for Jesus! And every single day, they continued telling people that Jesus is the Savior of the World.
philip-and-the-ethiopian: One day an angel from God came to a follower of Jesus named Philip and told him to go to a certain road in the desert. So Philip got up and went. Now, while he was on that road, he met a man from a faraway country. This man had traveled a long way to worship God, and now he was heading back home in his carriage. While he was sitting in his carriage he began reading a book from one of God’s prophets. Then God’s Spirit told Philip to go over to that carriage. So Philip ran up to it, and he could hear the man reading. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you’re reading?” The man said, “No, I need someone to explain it to me.” So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him in the carriage. Well, the man was reading about a person who was led away like a sheep to be killed, but the person didn't say a word as he was being killed. And the man asked Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about here?” So, starting right there, Philip began to tell him all about Jesus. And when the man heard about Jesus, he believed in Jesus. As they were riding along the road, they came to some water. And the man got excited and said, “Look, there’s water right here! What’s stopping me from being baptized right now?” So, Philip agreed, and they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized the man as a sign that Jesus had cleansed his sins. Then when they came up out of the water, all of a sudden God’s Spirit took Philip away, and the man never saw him again. But the man went home, so happy and full of joy.
